title: Letter From H. B. M. Consulate-General, Shanghai, June 10, 1941 - J. Schleier

page_data.en:
FM. 2
G. 850-1-41

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
947
7 7 41

Special Branch Station. File No. Date July 7, 1941

SUBJECT: Letter from H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai dated June 10, 1941 - J. SCHLEIER.

With reference to the attached communication
enquiries show that nobody known as J. SCHLEIER
is registered at the Polish Consulate-General or
resides at 771/1 Tongshan Road. The letter
possibly refers to Izac SCHLEYER, a Rumanian subject,
born at la Suceava on October 25, 1886 who, until
recently, was domiciled in Lwow in Russian occupied
Poland. He is in possession of Rumanian passport
No. 263109/1367 issued by Consulate-General of Rumania
in Lwow on December 5, 1938 and which expired on
June 10, 1941.

He arrived in Shanghai with his wife and daughter
on February 2, 1941 in the ss. Hoten Maru after
travelling from Lwow via Poland and Siberia.

His passport describes him as a merchant by
profession and no information is available to indicate
that he is an expert in the leather business. He is,
however, reported to be an invalid suffering from
some mild form of paralysis.

Nothing is known by this office that would reflect
to his discredit.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH JUL 7 1941）
A.C. (Special Branch).

Ja. Picks
D.S.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
947
7 7 41

特务科分站。档案号。日期 1941年7月7日

事由：英国驻上海总领事馆1941年6月10日来函 - J. SCHLEIER。

就所附函件查询显示，波兰总领事馆并无名为 J. SCHLEIER 的登记人员，亦无人居住于同山路771/1号。该信函可能系指 Izac SCHLEYER，罗马尼亚籍人士，1886年10月25日出生于苏恰瓦（la Suceava），直至最近一直居住在俄占波兰的利沃夫（Lwow）。他持有罗马尼亚护照第263109/1367号，由罗马尼亚驻利沃夫总领事馆于1938年12月5日签发，已于1941年6月10日过期。

他与其妻女经波兰和西伯利亚从利沃夫出发，于1941年2月2日乘“Hoten Maru”号轮船抵达上海。

其护照载明其职业为商人，且无资料表明他是皮革业专家。然而，据报他是一名病患，患有某种轻度瘫痪。

本处未掌握任何有损其声誉的情况。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科 1941年7月7日）
A.C.（特务科）。

Ja. Picks
副督察长

page_data.en:
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
SHANGHAI
10th June, 1941.
947
7 7 41

Dear Mr. Sharman,

I should be grateful for any information
you can give me regarding a Mr. J. Schleier, a
Polish Jew, who is stated to be a leather expert
at 771/1 Tongshan Road, Shanghai.

Many thanks for any information you can
obtain.

Yours sincerely,

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.
page_data.zh:
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海
1941年6月10日。
947
7 7 41

亲爱的夏曼先生：

如蒙告知有关 J. Schleier 先生的任何信息，我将不胜感激。此人系波兰犹太人，据称是居住在上海同山路771/1号的皮革专家。

非常感谢您能获取的任何信息。

您真诚的，

V. 夏曼 先生，
助理总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

page_data.en:
July 7th 41.

Dear Mr. Cox,

With reference to your letter
dated June 10, 1941, I forward herewith
a copy of a Police report regarding Mr. J.
Schleier.

Yours sincerely,

Assistant Commissioner
(Special Branch)

（批：x Sent.
7/7.）

A. T. Cox, Esq.,
British Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
1941年7月7日。

亲爱的考克斯先生：

关于您1941年6月10日的来信，现随函附上有关 J. Schleier 先生的警务报告副本一份。

您真诚的，

助理总监
（特务科）

（批：已发送。
7/7。）

A. T. Cox 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。
